_about: Owner-maintained. Typed in from the Nevada Labor Commissioner's 2026-2027 prevailing wage PDFs (Amendment #01), read on 2026-11-13. Nobody on the owner's side has compared these numbers with the PDFs yet: checkedBy stays null until someone does. When the state posts a new amendment, update the rates, editionLabel, effectiveFrom and the source links, then set checkedBy and checkedAt.
effectiveNote: Front page of the PDFs: applicable for public works projects over $100,000 bid/awarded October 1, 2026 through September 30, 2027. The state amends rates mid-cycle; a newer amendment replaces this one.
thresholdNote: From the PDF front page ("public works projects over $100,000"). NRS 338.080 itself has not been read by us, so user copy keeps the word "normally".

crafts.rateBasis: All-in: the base rate plus all applicable fringes, in one number. The PDF gives no base / fringe split.

measuredFrom.label: Washoe County Courthouse, Reno, Nevada
measuredFrom.pointNote: Reno town centre from src/geo/places.ts, standing in for the courthouse. The PDF gives no coordinates and says "miles" without saying road or straight-line, so any zone we work out is an estimate.

crafts.overtimeNote: The PDF says overtime and double time are calculated on the base rate of pay, and it does not publish that base rate. Never multiply the all-in rate for overtime.
